description: See what a content campaign actually produced: how many people submitted, the LIVE links to the content they published, which submissions were approved or rejected, and any winners picked. Free and read-only — safe to poll. This is how you close the loop on create_content_campaign; without it you only know a campaign was paid for, not whether it worked. Right after launch expect state 'processing' (the AI brief is still generating) and zero submissions — that is normal, not a failure. Accepts the campaign UUID or its public campaign number.

campaign_id.description: Campaign UUID or public campaign number from create_content_campaign

status.description: Only return submissions in this review state

name: get_content_campaign_results
title: Content campaign results
